content.content: Resolution yields the target's loaded node document, not its path. A non-root target resolves to the document read from its sibling file; zzzzzzzz resolves to the root and yields no document.
content.rationale: Resolution must hand navigation something it can use; a path would make every caller re-open the file and re-decide the read the store already owns (S2-read, `nqktpzuu`), and would let callers reach the filesystem themselves. Yielding the loaded document keeps one read path — the one checking already covers (S2-validate) — so navigation stays behind the store.
